item.title: Mbongarero zanavenye zina tameke nosirugana sazo
item.description: Rudolf Gaiseb Presidente Netumbo Nandi- Ndaitwah kunakukazegurura nayina mbongarero zanavenye zountantatu ezi zina kutameka nayina nosirugana sazo. item.description: Sho omutse gwoshilongo Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah a patulula Omutumba gwOpashigwana mEtiyali, okwa thindi omuthindo kutya iilyo yomutumba gwopashigwana nayi nkondopaleke iilonga yawo okweeta ehumokomeho nokulongela oshigwana omauwanawa. item.title: A twa ovanhu vatatu nombele ndele te limangeleke
item.description: Omulumenhu weedula 41 okwa monifa okatekulu oshiponga, ina osho yo mumwainakadona eshi vati e va twa nombele nokonima yefimbo okwe limangeleka.
